Lemma
[Large-neighborhood estimates] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0132, page-0139 ↗ def:chow-iii-reduced-distance 1. ch19:19.47\group Reduced Geometry

For points $q_\tau $ with bounded reduced distance, there are universal constants so that on $B_{g(\tau )}(q_\tau ,A\sqrt\tau )$ both $\ell $ and $\tau R$ are uniformly bounded. This is the estimate used to control the cylindrical neighborhoods in the $\kappa $-gap argument.
